name: AiCard
description: A composable assistant card with header, body and footer slots. Its material follows the surrounding AiSurfaceProvider.

slots.name: Root
slots.signature: ({ tone, well, breakout, className, ...rest }: AiCardProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: breakout
props.description: A wide block (tables, charts, code, images): in a conversation it may break out wider than the text (R5.4).

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.

props.name: well
props.description:
A recessed well inside panels (code, logs, JSON) instead of a raised card. On the
canvas every card is a glass layer.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

slots.name: Header
slots.signature: ({ icon, iconTile, title, meta, actions, level, className, children, ...rest }: AiCardHeaderProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actions
props.description: Trailing ghost actions: copy, export, open in window.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph before the title. Pass it without a size.

props.name: iconTile
props.description: Put the icon in a toned tile (asks, entity cards).

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level inside the conversation outline.

props.name: meta
props.description: Data only (R2.2): row count, source, target.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading or title content.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.
